Lower Text: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon becomes suspended, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers with a play cost less than or equal to this Digimon's play cost.
Upper Text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. If a Tamer card with the [DigiPolice] trait is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, that Digimon can't unsuspend until the end of their turn.
